meta.title: Git worktree groups
meta.description: Organizes the sidebar workspace list (sidebar.workspaces) into a 3-level hierarchy (Project → Git worktree → Session). Discovers unregistered worktrees with lazy workspace registration, creates and removes worktrees in place, preserves sessions from deleted worktrees in a history bucket, and supports 3-level drag-and-drop ordering, progressive session expansion, and a Recent activity section.
